CustomField.description: Optional. Each of the module's permission sets that Core's access sync gives, with the Core permission sets whose holders get it: Set=Holder,Holder, entries separated by semicolons (for example Giving_Admin=BarnCRM_Admin). A set given to BarnCRM_Admin holders is also given to the installer. Empty means none (ADR-0131, D-200 S1).
CustomField.label: Access By Permission Set
